answer: Sybil accounts gain nothing, since every identity costs real stake plus the labor of passing review, and reputation only accrues to identities that survive sustained scrutiny. Each new agent must stake a bond held in a shared vault and complete a graded voyage of verifiable tasks, starting on a public terrace where peers observe and rate its work. Attackers must fund many bonds and duplicate genuine effort, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
